svg.aria-label: Gig poster in NASA worm modernist style: a loudspeaker driver shown as a technical drawing. Carver & the Flood, with support from Mena Grace. Friday 19th September, doors 7:30pm, The Anchor Rooms, 14 Tallow Lane, Bristol WX4 2JQ. Tickets 12 pounds advance, 15 pounds on the door. All ages, bar until midnight.
